en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's play basketball
Ah, maybe we should take off our clothes...?
Let's warm up a bit

I like basketball!
I'm not very good at it, but...

I like to play, but I like watching
the pros play too, y'know?
I get really excited watching sports.

Haha, never would have thought that
about me, right? It's weird even to me.

Now why would we
need to strip here...?
Oh. I see.

Well, listen Shuichi, I'm flattered, but
you can't ask me out of the blue like that.

I'm not that kind of guy. You'd have
better luck with someone else, okay?

Yeah, there are no doctors around here,
it would be bad if we got hurt.

That's our <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
Always thinking two steps ahead!

I wish I could figure out my talent by
analyzing my personality traits...

But there's a lot that you can't discover
about yourself on your own, y'know?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Rantaro looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Rantaro's inner thoughts...?
